source: can you make a game were you spawn in a big giant building and make it so when you turn to your left there is a summoning era were it cost 100$ to summon and add characters you can get like a spekerman from skibidi toilet and make him a common rarity and make him a 55% chance also add a guy called tv man that is a uncommon rarity that is 35% chance and a large cameraman from skibidi toilet then can you add a inventory bouton were you can equip your units that you rolled also can you add a telleporter that can fit 5 people in it and when you go in it there will be a start bouton to start it amedeitley then once you spawn in there will be a city but like a tiny one but you are like a little smaller then it the there be a path way where one side there will be a base called camera base then the over side of the path will be were the toilets from skibidi toilet spawn and at the top there will be a wave thing that tells you what wave you are on there will be 10 waves 1st wave will spawn 6 small skibidi toilets from skibidi toilet wave 2 will be 10 small skibidi toilets from skibidi toilet wave 3 will be 12 small skibidi toilets from skibidi toilet and a medium toilet then wave 4 will be 12 small skibidi toilets and 2 medium skibidi toilets then wave 5 you know each time it will get harder and harder until you get to wave ten and wave ten will be boss toilet oh yeah wave 5 to 7 will have large toilets then wave 8 to 9 will have big skibidi toilets ok now your units you can place down will have upgradeds and speaker man will have level 1 damage 30 range 10 ok and when you beat the waves it will give you 100$ oh yeah and by killing toilets it will give you cash to upgrade your units and also cameraman will be a starter unit you start with when you join the game

answers.ask: How big is the tiny city - one street with the base at the end, or several blocks?
answers.answer: Make it one small city street with the Camera Base on one side of the pathway and the toilets spawning from the other side.

answers.ask: Is the spawn building a separate map you teleport out of, or is it attached to the city?
answers.answer: The big spawn building should be a separate lobby map, and the teleporter takes players into the city match.

answers.ask: The teleporter fits five - is the whole run five players co-operating on one lane?
answers.answer: Yes, up to five players should play together co-operatively on the same lane for all 10 waves.

config.addendum:
LAYOUT FEATURES for this Strategy map. Build these as the actual structure of the space rather than as set dressing, keep them visually distinct from one another, and keep the whole layout legible in one view.

SHAPE OF THE SPACE - Enemy Lane: A single continuous, unchanging lane winding from spawn to the core that enemy waves are hard-coded to follow — no dead-end branches, no ambiguous self-crossings.

INCLUDE:
- Tower Placement Grid: Flat structural zones framing both sides of the track where players click to deploy defenders.
- The Core Base: A large structure at the end of the track, built as the visual focus of the defence.
- Track Pinch Point: A narrowing in the lane where waves bunch up and area damage pays off.
